heading_en: Match the solution to the cause
display_fil: Poster lang o pagtalakay ng ibang oras? Piliin ang tumutugon sa sanhi. Suriin ang oras, tao at gastos. Ang bagong serbisyo o pondo ay kailangan munang sang-ayunan ng may tungkulin.
display_en: A poster alone or discussion of another time? Match the response to the cause. Check time, people and costs. New services or funding need agreement from the responsible authority.

heading_fil: Mula mungkahi tungo sa napagkasunduang gawain
heading_en: Turn a proposal into agreed work
display_fil: Ngayong linggo: kausapin ang pamilya → ipasa ang pinagsamang gustong oras → talakayin ang trial sa midwife at planning team. Itala ang owner, resources, deadline, attendance measure at review date.
display_en: This week: consult households → aggregate preferred times → discuss a trial with the midwife and planning team. Record the owner, resources, deadline, attendance measure and review date.

display_fil: Kasama ang apektadong residente, health team at barangay o ibang ahensya kung kailangan. Ihiwalay ang kayang gawin ng BHW at kailangang desisyon ng iba. Ibalik sa residente ang napagkasunduan.
display_en: Include affected residents, the health team and barangay or other agencies as needed. Separate BHW actions from decisions others must make. Return the agreement to residents.

heading_fil: Kapag hindi gumana ang unang plano
heading_en: When the first plan does not work
display_fil: Mas maaga na ang schedule ngunit may hindi pa rin nakapunta. Balikan ang trabaho, gastos at abiso. Ihambing ang invited at attendance; baguhin ang maling palagay. Hindi sapat ang isang trial para sabihing lutas na.
display_en: The schedule moved earlier but visits were still missed. Recheck work, costs and notice. Compare invitations with attendance and revise the wrong assumption. One trial does not establish resolution.

display_fil: Sanhi → solusyon → owner at resources → deadline → sukatan at review. Kumpirmahin ang ambag bago mangako.
display_en: Cause → solution → owner and resources → deadline → measure and review. Confirm contributions before making promises.

display_fil: Ang plano ay may taong kikilos at paraan upang malaman kung bumaba ang hadlang.
display_en: A plan names who acts and how to tell whether the barrier decreased.

check.prompt_fil: Nagawa ang meeting ngunit hindi dumami ang nakarating. Ano ang tamang review?
check.prompt_en: The meeting happened but attendance did not improve. What review is useful?

options.fil: Ituring na tagumpay dahil natapos ang meeting.
options.en: Declare success because the meeting finished.

options.fil: Ulitin ang parehong plano nang walang bagong tanong.
options.en: Repeat the same plan without new questions.

options.fil: Balikan ang hadlang at ihambing ang invitations at attendance bago magbago.
options.en: Recheck barriers and compare invitations with attendance before revising.

check.feedback_fil: Ang ikatlong sagot ay sumusukat sa resulta. Ang meeting ay gawain, hindi patunay na nawala ang hadlang; ang basta pag-uulit ay maaaring maulit ang maling palagay.
check.feedback_en: The third response examines results. A meeting is an activity, not proof that a barrier disappeared; repetition may preserve the wrong assumption.
